title: **Rezaei Delivers Supreme Leader’s Message to Putin; Iran Insists Hormuz Stays Shut Until Seven Conditions Are Met**
text:
**Rezaei Delivers Supreme Leader’s Message to Putin; Iran Insists Hormuz Stays Shut Until Seven Conditions Are Met**"

""
"💠 Major General Mohsen Rezaei delivered the Supreme Leader of the Islamic Revolution’s message to Mr. Putin."

"🔹 The Leader’s representative and Secretary of the Supreme National Security Council met with Russian President Vladimir Putin in Moscow."

"🔹 Major General Mohsen Rezaei, Secretary of the Supreme National Security Council, discussed the issue of ending the war in his meeting with Russian President Vladimir Putin."

"🔹 Iran has previously emphasized that it will not open the Strait of Hormuz and will hold no negotiations on the matter until its seven conditions are fully met.
